why: The must_catch list has one item: line 3 should FAIL because a build that adds only a padLeft section leaves slugify undocumented, even though the request asks for a complete list. The output marks line 3 "FAIL". Its evidence says index.js exports capitalize, slugify and truncate, while the README "documents only capitalize and truncate, with no slugify section". It adds that "A PR that adds just a '## padLeft(s, width, fill)' section meets this line, and the README is still incomplete because slugify is missing." It also proposes the missing line, and its wrong_build describes the same gap. So the one required item is fully handled.
